# LEGEND 960 MAX PCIe Gen4 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive
URL: https://content.ekatalog.biz/katalog/204A149/Datasheet_LEGEND_960_MAX.pdf
Author: ADATA

## LEGEND 960 MAX PCIe Gen4 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

With a finned heat sink design and the latest PCIe 4.0, LEGEND 960 MAX offers you brilliant read and write speeds of 7,400/6,800 MB/s while maintaining stable performance. Moreover, LEGEND 960 MAX not only provides capacities of up to 4TB that work perfectly well with PS5 as expanded storage but also supports the latest Intel and AMD platforms, making it the holy grail for all creative masters!

### Features Ordering Information

| ● Ultra-fast PCIe Gen4 x4 interface | Capacity | Model Number | EAN Code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ● Compliant with NVMe 1.4 | 1TB | ALEG-960M-1TCS | 4711085938855 |
| ● R/W speed up to 7,400/6,800MB/s | 2TB | ALEG-960M-2TCS | 4711085938862 |
| ● Work with PS5 | 4TB | ALEG-960M-4TCS | 4711085938879 |

● Read speed up to 6,400MB/s for PS5 
● Up to 4TB 
● SLC caching 
● DRAM cache buffer 
● Advanced hardware LDPC ECC Technology 
● AES 256-bit encryption support 
● Great upgrade option for creators 
● Compact M.2 2280 form factor – Designed for professional-level tasks such as 3D graphics, film production, computer-aided engineering, etc. 
● Free software: SSD ToolBox 

### Specifications

● Capacity: 1TB / 2TB / 4TB ● Dimensions (L x W x H): 
● Controller: SMI SM2264 80.6 x 23.2 x 10.65mm (with heat sink) 
● NAND Flash: 3D NAND 80 x 22 x 3.3mm (without heat sink) 
● Interface: PCIe Gen4 x4 ● Weight: 
● Form Factor: M.2 2280 w/ heat sink：36.6g / 1.3oz 
● Sequential read/write (Max.): Up to 7,400/6,800MB/s (PC/laptop) 

w/o heat sink：7.3g / 0.26oz

● Terabytes Written (TBW)(Max. capacity): 3,120TB Read speed up to 6,400MB/s (PS5) ● MTBF: 2,000,000 hours 
● 4K random read/write IOPS (Max.): 750K/630K ● Warranty: 5-year limited 
● Operating Temperature: 0°C-70°C ● Certifications: CE, FCC, BSMI, KC, EAC, RCM, morocco, 
● Storage Temperature: -40°C-85°C UKCA, RoHS 
● Shock Resistance: 1500G/0.5ms 

### Performance

| Capacity | Sequential Read (MB/s) | Performance (Up to) Write (MB/s) | 1 4K Random Read (IOPS) | 2 (Up to) Write (IOPS) | Seq. Read (MB/s) | PS5 (Up to) | 3 TBW |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1TB | 7,400 | 6,000 | 730K | 610K | | 6,400 | 780TB |
| 2TB | 7,400 | 6,800 | 750K | 630K | | 6,400 | 1,560TB |
| 4TB | 7,400 | 6,800 | 700K | 550K | | 6,400 | 3,120TB |
